eir.0010 = {
	type = character_event
	title = eir.0010.t
	desc = eir.0010.desc
	theme = war
	cooldown = { years = 4 }
	left_portrait = {
		character = scope:eir_norse_lord
		animation = personality_bold
	}

	trigger = {
		eir_is_irish_ruler_trigger = yes
		is_ai = no
		eir_viking_age_trigger = yes
		eir_has_coast_trigger = yes
		is_at_war = no
		NOT = { has_character_flag = eir_paid_danegeld }
		NOT = { has_character_flag = eir_viking_cooldown }
		any_ruler = {
			is_ai = yes
			is_ruler = yes
			highest_held_title_tier >= tier_county
			culture ?= { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_north_germanic }
			is_at_war = no
			NOT = { has_truce = root }
			NOT = { this = root }
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		eir_pick_norse_invasion_effect = yes
		add_character_flag = { flag = eir_viking_cooldown years = 4 }
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0010.a
		stress_impact = {
			craven = minor_stress_impact_gain
			brave = miniscule_stress_impact_loss
		}
		eir_viking_invasion_effect = yes
		ai_chance = { base = 60 }
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0010.b
		stress_impact = {
			greedy = miniscule_stress_impact_gain
		}
		remove_short_term_gold = medium_gold_value
		eir_defender_levy_effect = yes
		eir_viking_invasion_effect = yes
		ai_chance = { base = 20 }
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0010.c
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				diplomacy >= 12
				has_trait = gregarious
				has_trait = generous
			}
		}
		stress_impact = {
			paranoid = minor_stress_impact_gain
			trusting = miniscule_stress_impact_loss
		}
		random_list = {
			50 = {
				desc = eir.out.jarl_accepts
				modifier = {
					add = 15
					diplomacy >= 14
				}
				modifier = {
					add = 10
					has_trait = generous
				}
				scope:eir_norse_lord = { add_opinion = { target = root modifier = eir_hospitality_opinion opinion = 30 } }
				add_hook = { target = scope:eir_norse_lord type = favor_hook }
				add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_hospitality_modifier years = 5 }
			}
			40 = {
				desc = eir.out.jarl_refuses
				remove_short_term_gold = minor_gold_value
				eir_viking_invasion_effect = yes
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 20 }
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0010.d
		stress_impact = {
			arrogant = minor_stress_impact_gain
			brave = miniscule_stress_impact_gain
		}
		remove_short_term_gold = major_gold_value
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_danegeld_modifier years = 3 }
		add_character_flag = { flag = eir_paid_danegeld years = 3 }
		add_prestige = -25
		ai_chance = { base = 5 }
	}
}
